description: Approved StudioFlow source identity and generated assets for the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-137 restoration of the complete Notes workspace. The workspace was approved under the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-122 family and then silently left the shipping bundle when the TPI-STUDIOFLOW-130 release baseline pinned a sibling source lineage that never contained it; this baseline restores it on the released lineage together with every TPI-STUDIOFLOW-131/132R/133/134/135 correction. Production deployment additionally requires the Notes schema migrations recorded in productionSchemaRequirements, which are not authorized by this baseline alone.

productionSchemaRequirements.reason: The complete Notes workspace reads and writes studio_note_* tables. Deploying it before those tables exist serves an interface that cannot persist, so the guarded production release refuses to deploy until the schema is present.
